class.name: JRPGChangeStateCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: adds a state to an actor or the party, or removes it.
class.description: Adds state [member state_id] to the actors, or removes it with [member remove] ([method JRPGActorState.add_state], [method JRPGActorState.remove_state]). Adding state 1 knocks the actors out; removing it revives them with 1 HP. A state an actor resists is not added. An added state's duration is drawn from the game's misc random stream. Authority: server.

members.member: Removes the state rather than adding it.
